Equality phases and symmetry are attainable; a strict convex one-dimensional polynomial yields the globally sharp U=2g threshold, energy and entire minimizing family, including the endpoint. Direct linearization of the source ODE in a co-rotating frame yields [[U-g,-g],[g,-(U-g)]], eigenvalues ±√(U(U-2g)). Partial trace and entropy Taylor expansion are exact. A standalone standard-library script passed 5742 independent finite checks; experiments supplement rather than prove universal claims.
